episodes.title: Did Odysseus Discover America?
episodes.description:
[Lantern Jack]

Could the Odyssey preserve echoes of long-lost voyages beyond the Mediterranean—perhaps even across the Atlantic? A speculative discussion informed by Homeric scholarship, archaeology, and ancient literature.
***
To support this show and our mission to bring the classics to the general public, please visit https://patreon.com/greecepodcast  
***
